items.title: Install CVC Helper Test and check Android updates
instructions: Open the supplied link in Android Chrome and install CVC Helper Test once. Check Impostazioni shows 0.4.0. Create a synthetic course and fictitious student.

Reply “D3-PHONE-UPDATE: installed 0.4.0” with your device, browser and Android version. Keep this installation. The agent then publishes 0.4.1 from the same verified source at this same address and tells you when it is ready.

After that notice, switch away from the test app, return and time the update offer. Type a student-note change and immediately tap Aggiorna; note whether Salvataggio… or Salvato was shown. Check the edit survives and Impostazioni shows 0.4.1. Do not reinstall.

With enlarged text, check Allievi + and the Equipaggi controls with a person selected. Try Cerca aggiornamenti in airplane mode. Report the link, versions, offer time, saved edit and reachable controls; follow Updates and versions in docs/DEVICE_CHECKS.md.
items.expected: The 0.4.0 → 0.4.1 update appears within one minute of returning, without reinstalling; the typed edit survives and controls remain reachable. Only your actual phone observations can pass this check.

items.title: Check course files, persistent storage and full reset on Android
instructions: This check is not ready yet. Complete D3-PHONE-UPDATE first; the agent keeps that pinned build fixed and will provide D4 through the same permanent CVC Helper Test installation afterwards.

Once this item is READY, use fictitious people only. In Impostazioni read Conservazione dei dati, prepare the course file, save it and share it to another app. Check its availability and that its filename contains no personal name.
Import that saved file: check the course preview, cancel once, then explicitly confirm replacement. Reopen the course and check students, notes, duties and crews; close and reopen the app again.

With synthetic data only, confirm Azzera tutti i dati locali and check the app reopens without a course. Confirm the regular CVC Helper app retains its own course. Follow Course files and full local reset in docs/DEVICE_CHECKS.md.
Report D4-PHONE-TRANSFER with the supplied build/address, device, browser and Android version and the actual observed results, including the receiving app and persistent-storage status.
items.expected: The actual Android share/save/import round trip preserves the synthetic course. Storage permission is reported honestly, full reset completes without restoring erased data, and the regular app retains its course. No simulated or inferred device PASS.
